sarah: 10:00 prep — AV check in 5m. I'll run slide deck sync then do a mic sweep. @leo @raj can you confirm streaming bridge health? also we need to fit a 10m leadership Q&A after roadmap, thinking to timebox it.

leo: Mic A swapped to podium, levels look good. seeing encoder CPU spike ~82% on host-3, restarting encoder container now.

raj: saw cert-renew alert for streaming-bridge.prod earlier, starting a cert rotation + nginx restart, will post logs here.

deploy-bot: cert-rotation job started (id: cr-2026-03-176981).

raj: rotation applied, nginx back. sample log line: `nginx[1234]: TLS handshake succeeded` (no more cert errors).

leo: encoder container restarted. quick OBS tip: if CPU stays high, switch to `low-cpu` preset: `--encoder-profile low` — reduces quality slightly but keeps latency.

emily: small agenda tweak — can we swap "infra deep-dive" and "customer stories" so leadership Q&A happens earlier? also propose we cut Q&A to 8m to keep schedule.

sarah: ok to swap. @maria can you handle Q&A note-taking and clip timestamps?

maria: yup, I'll mark questions in the live doc and timestamp clips. doc: https://docs.internal/allhands/notes (will add a Q&A section).

leo: still seeing intermittent packet drops from edge-east, ~0.4% over last 30s. i've enabled routing fallback to edge-west for the stream. monitoring. :thumbsup:

sarah: good catch. last check — are captions on and language tag set? @maria

maria: captions are enabled but encoder metadata missing language tag, toggling in OBS and re-saving the scene now.

deploy-bot: encoder restart successful — rolling v1.4.7 -> v1.4.8 (streaming-encoder).

sarah: perfect. Meet in 7m. leadership Q&A will be timeboxed — bring up to 2 short questions. if you have a multi-part ask, drop it in #product-postmortem and we'll follow up after the meeting.
